text:
Maria Chen: opened PR to consolidate function-calling + structured-output guidance. main goals: clearer parse fallback examples, a compact JSON schema snippet, and an SDK sample showing `responseEnvelope` handling. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

Eli Turner: saw it, thanks. quick skim: guardrail section looks good but the fallback examples are still verbose. can we add a tiny `fallback()` shim example?

Maria Chen: yup that's in my TODO. thinking of a short shim like:```js
function fallback(resp) {
  try { return JSON.parse(resp); } catch(e) { return { text: resp }; }
}
```

Kunal Patel: minor nit: in the schema example we should clarify `nullable` vs optional arrays. folks keep tripping on `[] | null`. propose this snippet:```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "items": { "type": ["array", "null"], "items": { "type": "string" } }
  }
}
```

Priya Sharma: also add a line showing how to coerce older model outputs into the new envelope shape. e.g., `if (!resp.output) { resp = { output: resp }; }`

Sam Wu: SDK snippet needs 1) streaming example and 2) non-streaming fallback. can we keep both but super short? two 6-line blocks max.

Maria Chen: yep will keep both. draft snippets:```js
// streaming handler
client.stream({model, prompt}).on('data', d => parseChunk(d));
// fallback
const parsed = tryJson(resp) || { text: resp };
```

Eli Turner: link hygiene: there are a couple of broken anchors in existing docs we referenced. specifically the "parse heuristics" anchor moved. can we add redirects or update links in the PR?

Maria Chen: good catch — will update anchors and add a small note in CHANGELOG about moved anchors.

Kunal Patel: tests: add 2 small examples under examples/parse-regressions/ that we can run in CI. one for `null` arrays, one for plain-text fallback. they should be single-file fixtures.

Maria Chen: agree. I'll add fixtures and a tiny mocha test. cc @docs-bot to trigger link-checker after push.

docs-bot: scheduled: repo link-checker will run on next push and report failures in this thread.

Priya Sharma: wording request: change "robust" -> "graceful" in the guardrails paragraph. clearer for readers.

Maria Chen: done in latest commit. pushed fixtures + docs update. PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 (updated)

Sam Wu: landed my review for the SDK snippets, small style nit only. left one comment about naming `responseEnvelope` -> `envelope` for brevity.

Eli Turner: LGTM pending link-checker. if it passes, we can merge and ship a small docs release tomorrow.

Kunal Patel: added the two example fixtures in a follow-up commit. CI tests are green locally.

docs-bot: link-checker: 1 failure — anchor not found: `#parse-heuristics`. affected files: docs/guide/structured-output.md.

Maria Chen: fixing anchor now, will push in 5.

Maria Chen: pushed anchor fix and updated redirects file. link-checker re-run requested.

docs-bot: link-checker: all checks passed.

Eli Turner: great — I can merge after one more maintainer approval. @Kunal or @Priya can you give a quick approve?

Kunal Patel: approved.

Priya Sharma: approved.

Sam Wu: leaving a thumbs in PR. :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: thanks all — merging now and will cut docs release v0.18 tomorrow morning. closing thread.
